description: Hard-stop a mission: every agent run of it stops and its work in progress is lost. The pull request stays open, and start_mission starts the mission again. To stop one agent run only, use stop_agent_run. Requires the missions:write scope.

issueId.description: The mission's issue id: a Linear key or a GitHub Issues id, e.g. SHIP-412

name: stop_mission
title: Stop a mission
